question:
(i) Define an electric dipole.
(ii) Define electric dipole moment and state its direction.

options.A:
(i) A pair of equal charges having the same sign separated by a small distance
(ii) $\vec p=q\vec d$, directed from positive charge to negative charge
options.B:
(i) A pair of equal and opposite charges separated by a small distance
(ii) $\vec p=q\vec d$, directed from negative charge to positive charge
options.C:
(i) Any two charges placed at a large distance
(ii) $\vec p=\frac{q}{d}$, directed perpendicular to the dipole axis
options.D:
(i) A single point charge
(ii) $\vec p=qd^2$, with no definite direction
